title: BWF World Junior Championships: Jagsher, Nishchal, Dev Progress to Round of 16
indian_angle: Several promising Indian junior shuttlers, including Jagsher Singh Khangurra, Nishchal Chand, and Dev Ruparelia, have advanced to the round of 16 at the BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: Jagsher Singh Khangurra dug deep to beat Thailand’s Punnatat Prempunpong 15-11, 10-15, 17-15, while Nishchal Chand comfortably beat Kong Wei Xiang of Malaysia 15-9, 15-11, securing their spots in the round of 16.

title: Denmark Open: Ashmita Chaliha Advances, Unnati Hooda Exits After Tough Battle
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Ashmita Chaliha has progressed in the Denmark Open, securing a spot in the next round, while Unnati Hooda faced a challenging defeat.
summary: Ashmita Chaliha fought past Kaloyana Nalbantova at the Denmark Open 2026 and will now face either Mia Blichfeldt or Akane Yamaguchi. Fellow Indian Unnati Hooda, however, lost a tough battle.

title: Archery Premier League: Knights, Marathas Lead; Yodhas Bounce Back
indian_angle: The Archery Premier League is a prominent domestic Indian sports event, showcasing top Indian archery teams like Kakatiya Knights and Mighty Marathas.
summary: Kakatiya Knights and Mighty Marathas maintained their strong positions at the top of the Archery Premier League 2026 standings. The Marathas, who started with two losses, have now won five consecutive matches, while Prithviraaj Yodhas also bounced back.
